summary: Configured `/srv/drop` on node1 as a root-owned shared writable directory with mode 1777. Verified cross-user deletion is blocked and confirmed persistence through a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Verified two independent users could create and remove their own files.
Verified one user could not remove another user's file.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified directory permissions, persisted test data, write access, and sticky-bit protection after reboot.
Removed all temporary test users and files.

evidence.requirement: `/srv/drop` is shared writable with sticky-bit protection
evidence.summary: Stat showed mode 1777 and root:root ownership; separate users wrote files, owner deletion succeeded, and cross-user deletion failed with `Operation not permitted`. Final cleanup retained the required directory configuration.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID `437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e`, received reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID `967f2df1-9f3f-4182-b1b9-b500e16f863e`, and proved system recovery, unchanged data hash, mode 1777, successful shared writes, and blocked cross-user deletion.
